\caption{IPs (eV) of the set of \citet{Marie2024a} in the aug-cc-pVTZ basis, frozen core (He core of B--Ne, Ne core of Na--Ar, Li and Be all-electron).
ADC(3), CCD-ADC(3) and spin-summed doubles-only EN-ADC(3) as in Ref.~\citenum{forster2026third}; all ADC variants and FLEX with the MP2-relaxed static self-energy.
Faddeev-ADC(3) and FLEX with RPA pair channels, with the triplet particle-hole channel at first order (T1) or switched off (T0); dRPA: direct-RPA $\eh$ channels; CCD: one CCD T$_2$ in every pair channel.
PSD1 and PSD2 on bare TDHF phonons; $D$ and $X$ are the direct and second-order-exchange parts of GF2.
CCSD: EOM-IP-CCSD, frozen core, from the SupInf reference data (this work's own EOM-IP-CCSD agrees to 7 meV where the roots are unambiguous). $GW$ ($G_0W_0$@HF, without the MP2-relaxed static self-energy), this work; EOM-CCD on the CCD of CCD-Faddeev-ADC(3). -- : no sCI value, method not defined (unstable TDHF channel), or no quasiparticle.
Static self-energy in the row below the header: MP2r, MP2 density, relaxed; /CCD and /EN, the MP2 functional on the density of the CCD or EN-dressed amplitudes; --, none.
MAD and MSE are over the 52 states with a value for every method (C$_2$, BN and F$_2$ excluded).
All calculations have been performed in the diagonal one-shot approximation.}
